name: AutoGPT
description: Save hours every week with AI agents that handle repeatable work on your behalf—running on your own Unraid server and under your control. Tell AutoPilot what you want done or customize every step in the visual Builder, then run your agents on demand, on a schedule, or from a trigger. See Requirements for setup, memory, and first-account security guidance.

paths.name: App Data
paths.description: Persistent accounts, agents, databases, memory, workspaces, and generated secrets.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Host port for the AutoGPT web interface. The container port remains 3000.

variables.name: Public URL
variables.description: Exact browser origin, for example http://192.168.1.10:3000. If this differs from the HTTP server-IP WebUI shortcut, open this configured URL directly.

variables.name: First Account Email
variables.description: Exact email address allowed to create the initial account.

variables.name: Allow New Accounts
variables.description: Leave true for first setup. Set false after creating and promoting the intended account.
